messages:
maria: RFC: we need to finalize tenant audit access model + KMS ops for exported logs. Thoughts?

devon: TL;DR: admins see full tenant audit; members see filtered events; exports must be scoped + signed.

sophia: Can we get a clear matrix? admin vs owner vs member vs support vs svc accounts — want explicit read/write/export perms.

maria: Proposed matrix (initial):
- admin: full read/export/decrypt
- owner: full for their tenant
- member: read own-resource events only (no export)
- support: metadata-only read (redacted), export blocked by default
- svc-account: scoped by role/contract

eli: Quick question: scoped tokens — should a token scoped to tenant T automatically grant audit:read for T? or require explicit audit scope?

devon: Require explicit audit:read scope. We shouldn't conflate runtime action scopes with audit access. Gateway should enforce scope and tenant binding.

sophia: KMS note: exported log blobs are encrypted with tenant KMS key. Decrypt/rewrap ops must be gated to tenant-admin + security on-call with justifications. Audit the rewrap request as a privileged event.

maria: Schema changes proposal (minimal additions): actor_role, actor_org, actor_ip, request_id, pii_masked (bool), retention_flag, event_signature. Also add export_request_id when an export happens.

devon: Example event (for validation):
```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-11-02T15:22:09Z",
  "tenant_id": "t-12345",
  "event_type": "model.invoke",
  "actor_id": "u-234",
  "actor_role": "member",
  "actor_org": "redwood-acme",
  "actor_ip": "1.2.3.4",
  "request_id": "r-9876",
  "pii_masked": true,
  "details": {"model":"hippo-1.0","tokens":42},
  "event_signature": "sig:v1:abcdef..."
}
```

maria: For customer-facing audit downloads: we validate schema server-side, run PII scan, and attach a service signature + timestamp. If anything fails, return 422 with a validation report.

eli: Also consider signed manifests for exported batches so customers can verify integrity after decrypt. Attachful signature and signature algorithm in manifest.

devon: On RBAC side we need tests: unit tests that simulate scoped tokens, cross-tenant token misuse, and export attempts without audit:read. Add integration test for gateway enforcement.

sophia: Incident triage flows: security on-call can request temporary audit-read for their user via just-in-time (JIT) flow. JIT token is ephemeral, auto-revoked, and the JIT request + reason gets an audit event that is immutable.

maria: Agree. Add a retention_flag field on JIT grants to mark elevated sessions for longer forensic retention.

infra-bot: deploy:feature-flag enabled: "tenant-audit-export-validation" on staging at 1836129070.

auditsvc-bot: note: export blobs for tenant t-12345 pending encryption with kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abc-123 at 1836129090.

devon: Next actions:
- dev: implement gateway scope check for audit:read (devon)
- eng-ml: add actor_role/actor_org to runtime events (sophia)
- infra: enforce KMS rewrap RBAC + JIT token plumbing (eli)
- security: write export validation + PII scan runbook (maria)

maria: timeline? aim for feature-flag rollout to staging this week, prod next week if tests pass. Any blockers?

sophia: Need clarity on redaction rules for support-level views. Will sync with privacy legal.

devon: I'll add gateway tests today.

eli: I'll draft the KMS policy and JIT token api spec by EOD.

maria: cool thanks — will follow up in a short RFC doc and link here when ready.
